asset.name: I18nAdapter
asset.description: Connects messages, pluralization, number and date formatting, writing direction, and locale switching to the scenario's internationalization system.

requires.reason: Boundary types come from the shared framework-light vocabulary rather than being redeclared per adapter.

rationale: Direction reporting is the load-bearing part for the rest of the catalog: without it the right-to-left half of the locale capture axis cannot be satisfied even once the axis is wired.
